-- Add welcomeMessageSeen column to users if it doesn't exist
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN welcomeMessageSeen INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;

-- Create welcome_messages table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS welcome_messages (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  organizationId INT,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  subMessage TEXT,
  ctaText VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Get Started' NOT NULL,
  ctaUrl VARCHAR(500),
  imageUrl VARCHAR(500),
  isActive INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  showForNewGoogleUsers INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  INDEX idx_welcome_org (organizationId),
  INDEX idx_welcome_active (isActive)
);
